answer: Sybils that split identities forfeit the full bond per clone, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds plus slashed history. At dawn each epoch, agents must post a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation and stake it on a public ridge of reputation. Honest peers cross-verify on a shared ledge of attestations, and any duplicate fingerprint triggers immediate slashing, making mass identity farming economically irrational.
